$comment: Tracked project settings. DELIBERATELY hooks-only — no permissions keys, ever: the per-machine permission layer lives in the untracked .claude/settings.local.json on each checkout, and a tracked permissions block here would shadow it for every machine at once. The SessionStart hook is the corpus-first rule (CLAUDE.md compliance block) made mechanical: it verifies/materializes the Selling Guide corpus at the start of every session and prints a loud directive when it cannot — it informs (always exit 0); ci.yml's corpus gate steps are what block.
